Interface PoweredUpPort

public interface PoweredUpPort
The Powered Up hub intrinsics as an interface: NativePoweredUpPort drives the real hub on the board, and a mock or fake takes its place in a unit test through RemotePoweredUpHub(PoweredUpPort, io.github.jabrena.juno.hardware.time.Clock).
